decisions.title: Transactional persistence and canonical serialization
decisions.problem: OPEN-08 requires an explicit scoped policy before affected operations.
decisions.rationale_and_alternative: start with one local SQLite registry, one writer and immutable artifact payloads. Store small JSON envelopes/bodies, events, dependency edges, trial identities and freeze manifests in the same database transaction. Use foreign keys, uniqueness constraints, append-only application APIs and `synchronous=FULL`; verify actual settings on connection. Large data/result blobs are external, content-addressed files staged, flushed and hash-verified before registry reference commitment. An uncommitted staged blob grants no authority. Recovery checks committed references and quarantines missing/corrupt blobs; harmless orphan staging files can be reclaimed under a separate retention policy. Full policy, rejected alternatives, limits and acceptance cases: 14_RETAIL_RESEARCH_CONTRACT.md#8-open-08-persistence-serialization-and-recovery.
